quotes.text: Did a 3/4 day combo fishing and sightseeing tour with our family group of 9 people, including 4 small children. Captain Vik, Preston and crew were great. We caught our limits, saw a glacier calving, saw whales and sea lions and puffins — it was amazing. Of course, the crew doesn’t control nature and some of that is luck of the draw, but the crew was fantastic interacting with us and the kids, happily going where we asked, circling backwards to get a closer look at wildlife we thought we had seen, etc. Thank you!

Absolutely wonderful experience! The sightseeing tour was unforgettable — we saw incredible wildlife up close, from whales to eagles, all in their natural habitat. The captain was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the trip feel both safe and personal. Highly recommend this tour for anyone wanting a truly special way to experience Alaska’s beauty.read moreread less

Me and my buddy went out with Jeff on July 2nd 2025 for salmon and rockfish and he was GREAT! We learned some regional WW II history (Barwell Island) on the way out and Jeff put us on silvers and rockfish till we got our limits of EVERYTHING. We saw many whales, puffin, sea lions etc. Very memorable, thanks Jeff! Mike G

Had a good trip. Clear day, little windy. Fishing was slow, but our Captain Jeffrey, worked hard to keep this group comfortable and chase fish. Although Silvers were slow, we still got several and many other great fish. Over all had a great day. The captain worked hard the whole trip.read moreread less

Captain Nik and his crew took us out on the Voyager for a full day of salmon fishing. The entire trip was stunningly beautiful, everyone got their limit and the whales were absolutely incredible.read moreread less

Best Fishing and Sightseeing Trip Ever! Captain Jeff treated us to an amazing day of sightseeing and fishing! While cruising to fish, we saw glaciers, whales, sea otters, sea lions, and puffins. While fishing we caught various species including some nice sized King and Silver Salmon! The night before, we put a half of a scopolamine patch behind our ear and another half in the am and had no issues with motion sickness at all! Capt Jeff is such a knowledgeable fisherman and outdoorsman that you can't go wrong with him!read moreread less
